title: Interactive authentication needs password and feedback evidence
remediation: The deployment identity owner inventories each interactive sign-in and recovery surface and identifies the operator responsible for it. For each password-based surface, collect provider or component evidence for the password blocklist, protected transport, approved salted storage where passwords are stored, recovery reset and approved password selection rules. For every in-scope authentication surface, verify that input and responses obscure sensitive authentication details. Retain redacted screenshots and permitted and denied test results. Review password-specific applicability separately from feedback protection.

milestones.title: Approve the sign-in and recovery inventory and obtain operator policy, masked input and sanitized feedback evidence for each applicable surface
